Help & tips
Quick answers, and how to get the most out of MPA.
What is in the app
Games: Number Guess, Pong, Tic Tac Toe, Ludo, Sudoku and Chess. Your progress is kept on this device.
Utilities: a unit converter with eight categories and a binary converter.
Productivity: tasks, an expense tracker with a monthly budget and CSV export, and reminders.
Account: sign in with your MPA website account to keep tasks and expenses in step with the website.
Add things in one line (website)
On the MPA website, the Add anything box on your dashboard turns a short line into an expense or a task. Type it the way you would say it:

tea 20 → expense of ₹20 in Food, dated today
lunch 180 yesterday → expense of ₹180 in Food, dated yesterday
auto 40 cash → expense of ₹40 in Transport
rent 12000 → expense of ₹12,000 in Home & bills
shoes 2k → expense of ₹2,000 in Shopping (k means thousand)
call mom Friday 6pm → task "Call mom (6pm)", due next Friday
pay electricity bill tomorrow → task due tomorrow
submit report in 3 days urgent → high-priority task due in 3 days
Good to know
You always see what was understood and can change it before anything is saved.
Start with "expense:" or "task:" if it guesses wrong, for example "task: buy milk 2".
Dates you can use: today, tomorrow, yesterday, a weekday (fri), "in 3 days", "5 nov", "15/11". A weekday means the next one for a task and the most recent one for an expense.
Amounts can be written 20, ₹20, rs 20 or 2k. A number in the middle of a task, like "meeting room 4", is left alone.
Open the website
Questions
Who can see my tasks and expenses?

They are saved on this device. If you sign in, your MPA account keeps its own copy, and only you can see it when signed in. As the site owner I can reach the database as an administrator. Messages you send through Contact us are read by me.
Where is my game progress saved?
On this device. It is not on our server, so it does not follow you to another phone.
Does it work without internet?
Yes, for the games, converters, tasks, expenses and reminders. Signing in, syncing and sending a message need a connection.
How do reminders work?
Open Productivity and choose Reminders. Add a title, a date and time, and how often it repeats. At that time you get a notification on this device, so allow notifications when Android asks.
I forgot my password.
Use Forgot password on the Account tab. It opens the website; follow the email we send. The link works for one hour.
How do I get a copy of my data?
Sign in on the website and use Export my data. It gives you spreadsheet files and one backup file.
How do I close my account?
Account settings on the website has Deactivate account. Deactivating stops sign-in; it does not erase your information. To have it erased as well, send us a message through Contact us.
Still stuck? Contact us and quote your reference ID if you have one.
